name: community.http-request-tools
title: HTTP request tools
description: Provide HTTP tools for a configured service and explicitly allowed additional origins.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Default service origin used for relative request paths.

methods.title: Allowed methods
methods.description: HTTP methods the agent is permitted to use.

allowed_origins.title: Additional origins
allowed_origins.description: Optional HTTP or HTTPS origins the tool may access, one per line.

allow_any_url.title: Allow any HTTP/HTTPS URL
allow_any_url.description: Permit requests outside the configured origins. Use only for trusted agents.
